newsitem.title: USA: Edison Intl Q2 hurt by nuclear plant outage.
newsitem.headline: Edison Intl Q2 hurt by nuclear plant outage.

text.p: Edison International said Friday its second quarter earnings were hurt by an extended refueling outage at the San Onofre Nuclear Generating Station's 1,080 megawatt (MW) unit 3.
Edison, parent of Southern California Edison Co, reported second quarter earnings of 34 cents a share, down one cent from the same 1996 quarter.
But excluding one-time adjustments, the company said results were down 5 cents from the previous year's quarter.
The decrease was primarily attributed to the nuclear unit's outage, which began in mid-April and was most recently scheduled to end this weekend.
SoCal Edison owns 75 percent of the nuclear plant.
Edison said the drop in quarterly results was partially offset by lower operating costs, an increase in electricity sales, and the results of the company's continuing share repurchase program.
